description: This file defines Flutter widget components for displaying order processing progress, including visual indicators for different order statuses such as Ordered, Processing, Packed, Shipped, Delivered, and Canceled.

classes.name: OrderProgress
classes.description: A widget that displays the progress stages of an order visually, with indicators for each status.

classes.name: ProcessDotWithLine
classes.description: A visual component representing each stage with a dot and optional connecting lines.

methods.name: statusWidget
methods.description: Returns a widget (circle avatar) representing the current status, such as processing, not done, error, canceled, or completed.

methods.name: lineColor
methods.description: Determines the color of the connecting lines based on order status.
